sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT IX OF 2020
ACT IX OF 2020
BALOCHISTAN SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES
(HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ACT, 2020
An Act to establish the Hospitals and Dispensaries
Management Board in Balochistan
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
9th November, 2020]
No.
PAB / Legis; V(10) / 2020, dated 9.11.2020.---The Balochistan Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and
Dispensaries) Bill, 2020 (Bill No. 10 of 2020), having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 26th October, 2020 and assented to by the
Governor, Balochistan on 06th November, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of
the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Whereas,
it is necessary to establish the Hospitals and dispensaries Management Board;
to manage the seized and freezed Facilities; to ensure mainstreaming of
employees of such Facilities; to provide for the matters connected therewith
and ancillary thereto.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called as the Balochistan Seized and Freezed Facilities
(Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2020.
(2) It
extends to whole of the Balochistan and shall apply to such Facilities as may
be notified by the Government.
(3) It
shall come into force from such date as the Government may, by notification in
the official Gazette, specify.

It

2. Definitions.---In this Act unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or contract:
a) "Act"
means the Balochistan Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and
Dispensaries) Act, 2020:
b) "Board"
means the Board Constituted under Section 3 of the Act;
c) "Chairperson"
means the Chairperson of the Board;.
d) "Committee"
means a Committee constituted by the Board under the Act;
e) "Directorate"
means the Directorate established under section 7 of the Act;
f) "Government"
means Government of the Balochistan;
g) "Facilities"
means the hospitals, dispensaries, and ambulances freezed and seized under
section 2 of the United Nations (Security Council) Act 1948 (XIV of 1948) read
with the United Nations Security Council (Freezing and Seizure) Order 2019,
Published in the Gazette of Pakistan on 4 March, 2019, and any other Facility
notified by the Government under the Act and includes an establishment, a
property or an organization attached thereto;
h) "member"
means a member of the Board;
i) "prescribed"
means prescribed by the rules made or the regulations framed under the Act;
j) "regulations"
means the regulations framed by the Board under the Act;
k) "rules"
means the rules made by the Board under the Act' and
l) "Seizing
agency" means a seizing agency notified under section 2 of the United
Nations (Security Council) Act 1948 (XIV of 1948) read with the United Nations
Security Council (Freezing and Seizure) Order 2019, published in the Gazette of
Pakistan on 4 March, 2019.

3. Board.---(1) For the efficient management and control of
the Facilities, the Government shall, by notification in the official Gazette,
constitute a Board to be known as Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board.
2) The
Board shall be a body corporate, shall have perpetual succession and a common
seal, with power to enter into contracts and to acquire, hold and dispose of
property, movable and immovable, and shall in its name sue and be sued.
3) The
Board shall consist of the following:
a)
Secretary to the
Government, Health Department
Chairperson
b)
Secretary to the
Government , Finance Department or his nominee not below the rank of an
Additional Secretary;
Vice Chairperson
c)
Secretary to the
Government of, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department or his nominee not
below the rank of an additional Secretary;
Member
d)
Secretary to the
Government (Regulations Wing), Services and General Administration Department
or his nominee not below the rank of an Additional Secretary:
Member
e)
Special Secretary to
the Government, Home Department or his nominee not below the rank of an
Additional Secretary;
Member
f)
Three non-official
members, including at least one woman, to be nominated by the Chief Minister
Balochistan; and
Member
g)
Director of the
Directorate.
Member/ Secretary
The non-official members shall have such
qualification and experience and shall serve for such period as may be
prescribed through regulations.

6. Powers of the Board.---Subject to
the Provision of the Act, the Board shall have the powers to:
a) Acquire and dispose of a property and enter
into contracts;
b) Recruit and determine terms and conditions
of employees of the Facilities, including special Dispensation if required;
c) Formulate the budget of the Facilities;
d) Lay down the procedure for the conduct of
its business;
e) Set up any committee as may be required for
carrying out the purposes of the Act;
f) Hire the services of employees belonging to
the other provinces as one-time dispensation only; and
g) Delegate Powers to the Chairperson, a
Committee set up under the Act or any employees of the Board, except power to
make rules or frame regulations.

to manage the seized and freezed Facilities; to ensure mainstreaming of

and ancillary thereto.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
8. Transitional Provisions for employees of the
facilities.---Any person, not below the age of eighteen years,
employed in connection with the affairs of the facilities, in any capacity
immediately before the date notified under the Act, hereinafter referred to as
the "said date" shall be deemed to have been the employees of the
Board on such terms and conditions as the Board may determine;
Provided that such terms and conditions
shall not be less favorable than those admissible to an employee immediately
before coming in force of the Act;
Provided further that no such employee
shall be dismissed or removed from employment or reduced in rank by any
authority other than the Board.

10. Board Fund.---(1) There shall be a fund to be known as
Board Fund.
(2) the Board Fund shall consist of:
a) grant-in-aid made by the Government;
b) loans obtained from Government;
c) aid and loans obtained by the Board with the
prior approval of Government on such terms and conditions as may be approved by

salaries and other remunerations of the employees of the Board and payment of
rents and utilities.
